descriptions.glow-bloom: Glow/Bloom effect: source → high-pass level → blur → composite blend with original
descriptions.audio-visualizer: Audio-reactive spectrum visualizer: audio → FFT → Math → CHOP to TOP → output
descriptions.feedback-trail: Feedback trail: source → feedback TOP → composite → delay → feedback loop
descriptions.particle-system-basic: Basic POP particle system: sphere source → particle POP → noise force → trail → render
descriptions.composite-layers: Multi-layer composite: N sources → composite TOP (multi-input) → output
descriptions.glsl-shader: GLSL shader: constant time + texture inputs → GLSL TOP → output
descriptions.chroma-key: Chroma key: foreground + background → chromakey → composite → output
descriptions.edge-detect: Edge detection: source → edge TOP → composite blend with original → output
descriptions.kaleidoscope: Kaleidoscope: source → transform → mirror → kaleidoscope → output
descriptions.displacement-map: Displacement: source → displace TOP (driven by noise map) → output
